name: Small archetype diagnostic
scope: Repository fixtures, main-deck games only. Mixed card pools; no claim of format legality, tournament provenance or current metagame representativeness.

decks.reason: Pressure, burn, prowess and adventure decisions.
Discard, removal, threats and graveyard/transform decisions.
Counters, sweepers, planeswalkers and delayed win conditions.
